verdict.rationale: Stagehand has a first-party 'MCP integrations' best-practices page (stagehand-docs-26), but in v4 there is no autonomous loop: the developer calls the MCP tools and interleaves the results with Stagehand primitives, rather than Stagehand consuming the tools itself. The other MCP evidence describes Stagehand acting as an MCP server for other agents, which does not count toward this client-side story. Missing for 10: native registration of MCP servers so Stagehand (or its agent) can discover and invoke their tools, configuration docs for connecting servers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
